exarchate-of-africa: the reviewer asked for a Ceuta 709 mirror; the Muslim conquest of the Maghreb page does not support an Umayyad Ceuta in 709, so I did not add it to the Umayyad dossier and the mirror should not be requested.

Pages that contradict the review: Muslim conquest of Armenia is silent on the 680s; Hassan ibn al-Nu'man does not say who recovered Barqa; the Isfahan page says 642 but I kept Isfahan at 643 (Persia page puts it after Nahavand of December 642; sasanian-empire has 643), confidence 1, reasoning in the notes; the Ibn Khazim page says Khorasan returned in 692 while the Second Fitna page says 691 (I used 692 with the Ibn Khazim page); the Kusaila page dates Mamma to 688.
Battle_of_Sufetula is a disambiguation page; I used Battle_of_Sufetula_(647) for the thin item.
